issues.issue: Whether the RPD breached procedural fairness by not appointing a designated representative for the impaired appellant
issues.applicant_position: RPD should have appointed a designated representative; this breach is determinative of the appeal.
issues.result_text: RPD failed to recognise the appellant's impairment and need for a DR; decision set aside and returned for redetermination.

issues.issue: Whether the RAD can decide the appeal on the RPD record or should refer the matter back
issues.applicant_position: Counsel says the breach is determinative but does not specify a remedy; asks the RAD to intervene or refer back.
issues.result_text: Referral back ordered; the breach alone cannot make him a refugee, and the RAD cannot rely on the deficient record.

issues.issue: State protection and the merits of the fear in Grenada
issues.applicant_position: Raises other alleged RPD errors, not specified in the points.
issues.result_text: Merits of state protection not decided; referral back is not an instruction to allow or dismiss the claim.
